summary: @or-sdk/payments preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The npm package's `scripts.preinstall` runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) from GitHub into a temp directory and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled numeric string-array, `_0x`-style identifiers, and character-code string reconstruction; it lives at the tarball root and is not referenced from the SDK's declared `main` at `dist/cjs/index.js` or anywhere in `src/`. The chosen runtime is deliberately non-Node, which bypasses Node-based inspection and hides the payload behavior from ordinary review. The package's CHANGELOG references an internal repository at `gitlab.internal.onereach.io`, while the shipped tarball adds install-time dropper behavior that is not present in the TypeScript source that produced `dist/`, indicating the published artifact diverges from the upstream source tree. Installing the package causes arbitrary, obfuscated code to run on the installer's machine before any SDK code is imported.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
